verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a local skills plugin that writes per-plan workspace artifacts, so asking whether users can control retention and deletion of that data is a fair question. The evidence shows no user-facing retention or deletion controls. The automatic deletion of the `.superpowers/sdd/` workspace after a clean final review is fixed workflow behavior, not a user control. Refusing to force-remove worktrees with uncommitted files is a data-safety behavior, not retention control. Neither earns credit.
